adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated “hydrate credential from DB” logic in multiple places: EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents and EventManager.updateAllCalendarEvents both call prisma.credential.findUnique with an `include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}` and then manually construct a `credential` object (with appName, id, type, key, etc.). In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts a similar fallback exists but differs: it calls prisma.credential.findUnique without including `app.slug` and assigns the Prisma result directly to `calendarCredential` (no manual construction). This is concrete copy/paste with drift, creating a maintainability/architecture concern best addressed via a shared helper.
